database.description: Optional label when a probe touches PostgreSQL; pure in-memory runners may omit it.

editorPageP95Ms.description: Engineering trial p95 for a single revision-fenced Editor page (not an external SLO).

fullAssemblyMs.description: Wall time ceiling for assembling the full live-node tree at environment.nodeCount (generous for in-memory 10k).

maxPageBytes.description: Maximum serialized Editor page JSON size in bytes (Product contract: 4 MiB).

maxHeapDeltaBytes.description: Heap used delta ceiling for the full assembly workload (engineering trial only).

sameCollectionLockWaitP95Ms.description: p95 wait observed while contending writers serialize on one Collection.

crossCollectionParallelMs.description: Wall-time ceiling for parallel writers on distinct Collections (must beat a serial estimate).
